## 2. Selected Engineering & Research Projects (13 Factsheets)

### 1. Generative AI (GenAI) Video Generation
- **Category:** Agentic AI & GenAI | **Timeline:** Jan 2026 – Present
- **Architecture:** Autonomous multi-agent pipeline using Google ADK, GCP Vertex AI (document storage), Gemini Enterprise, Agent Engine Platform, and FastMCP. Features context-window summarisation, token-cost observability, dynamic prompting, and automated self-correction validation loops.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Slashed end-to-end delivery timeline from 5–14 days down to under 6 hours (from script generation to final video demo).

### 2. Media Analytics (POC)
- **Category:** Time Series & MLOps | **Timeline:** Jun 2025 – Oct 2025
- **Architecture:** Predictive ML and prompt engineering pipeline for inference explanation, insight extraction, and business KPI generation; models multi-channel budget allocation and predicts future investment growth using multi-timeseries forecasting.
- **Scope Note:** Internal capability proof-of-concept without commercial client metrics.

### 3. Price Elasticity (POC)
- **Category:** Causal ML & Pricing | **Timeline:** Jun 2025 – Jul 2025
- **Architecture:** Dynamic pricing architecture using Hierarchical Linear Models (HLM) (statsmodels, Python, Azure ML) with automated MLflow continuous retraining pipelines to model cross-product elasticity frontiers.
- **Scope Note:** Internal capability proof-of-concept without commercial client metrics.

### 4. Enterprise Analytics Chatbot
- **Category:** Agentic AI & GenAI | **Timeline:** Jul 2024 – Dec 2025
- **Architecture:** Conversational analytics agent (Streamlit, PostgreSQL) featuring a dedicated Intent Classifier to determine required insight types, paired with dynamic Text-to-SQL generation powered by Client Proprietary Internal LLMs.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Projected cycle time reduction for designing complex enterprise insights from 3 months down to under 15 days.

### 5. Intelligent QA / BA Chatbot
- **Category:** Agentic AI & GenAI | **Timeline:** Apr 2024 – Apr 2025
- **Architecture:** Enterprise conversational system (FastAPI, Python) utilizing semantic policy retrieval, intent classifiers, and structured intent flows for automated policy Q&A and operational task execution.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Autonomously resolved 80% of internal policy document queries; automated RBAC-governed workflow execution and access request approvals/rejections.

### 6. LLM-Driven Predictive Modelling (POC)
- **Category:** Causal ML & Pricing | **Timeline:** Jul 2024 – Sep 2024
- **Architecture:** Unsupervised feature extraction pipeline using open-source LLMs via Ollama to discover ticket objective classes; aggregates class occurrences into hourly instance feature vectors fed into an existing deep LSTM sequence model for enhanced predictive sequence accuracy.
- **Scope Note:** Internal capability proof-of-concept without commercial client metrics.

### 7. LLM-Based Test Case Generator
- **Category:** Agentic AI & GenAI | **Timeline:** Nov 2023 – Mar 2024
- **Architecture:** QA automation toolchain (FastAPI, Python) parsing unstructured Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) to extract acceptance criteria and auto-generate structured Gherkin and TMMi test suites.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Accelerated test authoring cycle by 70%; ensured 100% test-to-requirement coverage mapping.

### 8. Healthcare Consumer Analytics
- **Category:** Causal ML & Pricing | **Timeline:** Jun 2022 – Oct 2023
- **Architecture:** Production ML pipeline on AWS SageMaker (Scikit-Learn, DataRobot) combining customer segmentation, causal inference uplift modeling, and SHAP explainability for account-level promotional strategy ranking.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Delivered projected $2.3M in cost savings at 90%+ model accuracy across all account-level promotion campaigns.

### 9. Demand Sensing MLOps
- **Category:** Time Series & MLOps | **Timeline:** Mar 2020 – Jun 2022
- **Architecture:** Distributed time series MLOps pipeline on Azure Databricks (PySpark, TensorFlow, Keras) with automated feature engineering, distributed model selection, and continuous retraining workflows.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Achieved 5% accuracy improvement, 10% better model selection, reduced training from 3 days to 2 hours, and 60% reduction in manual intervention.

### 10. Predictive Maintenance
- **Category:** Time Series & MLOps | **Timeline:** Dec 2019 – Mar 2020
- **Architecture:** Time-varying survival analysis pipeline (Cox Proportional Hazards, XGBoost, lifelines, Python) predicting EV component degradation windows paired with interactive Plotly operational HUDs.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Achieved 82% validation accuracy for early failure prevention.

### 11. Service Now Ticket Analytics
- **Category:** Time Series & MLOps | **Timeline:** Oct 2019 – Dec 2019
- **Architecture:** Deep learning sequence volume forecasting architecture (LSTM vs. MLP, TensorFlow, MySQL) featuring custom greedy Hungarian workload dispatch heuristics for agent routing.
- **Verified Operational Impact:** Achieved 85% validation accuracy with intelligent routing heuristics for optimized workload dispatch.

### 12. Supply Chain Demand Forecasting (POC)
- **Category:** Time Series & MLOps | **Timeline:** Apr 2019 – Oct 2019
- **Architecture:** Multivariate demand forecasting pipeline (statsmodels SARIMAX, pandas, Python) integrating dynamic NLTK VADER social media sentiment indices as exogenous regressors with grid-search hyperparameter optimization.
- **Scope Note:** Internal capability proof-of-concept without commercial client metrics.

### 13. Retail Video Analytics (POC)
- **Category:** NLP & Computer Vision | **Timeline:** Apr 2018 – Mar 2019
- **Architecture:** Computer vision pipeline (OpenCV, TensorFlow, Keras, Python) featuring frame-level CNN transfer learning for brand asset detection and multi-class classification across retail video streams.
- **Scope Note:** Internal capability proof-of-concept without commercial client metrics.
